LoanProcessingSystem_loanPayment_loanPay: The remaining amount decreases by the Loan repayment amount.
Airport_manageDevice_createDevice: The device identifier must be unused
the selected contact must identify an existing Staff member.
The system creates a Device with the supplied identifier, name and location.
The system links the Device to the selected Staff contact
Airport_raiseRepair_finishRepair: The referenced Device must be assigned to the supplied Staff member
whose Worker role value must be 3.
The system sets Repair.Process to the finished stage value 7.
Airport_manageUser_createStaff: The staff identifier must be unused.
The system creates a Staff member with the supplied identity, password, phone and role.
If bossid identifies an existing Staff member, the system links the new Staff member to that Boss.
AutomatedTellerMachine_checkBalance_inpu: with no additional business condition required.
If the card exists, the ATM stores that card as the current card, marks the card identifier as validated and returns true.
If the card does not exist, the ATM marks the card identifier as unvalidated and returns false.
AutomatedTellerMachine_withdrawCash_with: The card identifier and password must be validated
a current BankCard must be present
the card balance must cover the requested amount.
The card balance decreases by the withdrawn amount.
The session records the withdrawal and its amount.
CoCoME_orderProducts_placeOrder: The order amount becomes its amount before this operation plus the subtotal of every associated OrderEntry, with distinct entries of equal subtotal each contributing.
When the order has no entries, its amount remains unchanged.
CoCoME_processSale_enterItem: a current Sale that exists and is incomplete
a scanned Item that exists and has positive stock.
The entered quantity must not exceed the Item stock
The system creates a SalesLineItem linked to the Sale and Item, recording the quantity and subtotal.
The system stores the new SalesLineItem
makes it the current sale line.
The Item stock decreases by the entered quantity.
CoCoME_processSale_makeCashPayment: The tendered amount must cover the Sale amount
A CashPayment records the tendered amount and change and is linked to the Sale.
The system links the Sale to the current Store
LibraryManagementSystem_borrowBook_borro: The User and BookCopy must exist.
The User must have NORMAL borrowing status and no suspension days.
A BACHELOR Student must have fewer than 20 loans, a MASTER Student fewer than 40, another Student fewer than 60, and a Faculty user fewer than 60.
The copy must be AVAILABLE, or ONHOLDSHELF and marked reserved with a matching open reservation for this user.
The system creates a new unreturned Loan linked to the User and BookCopy with today as the loan date.
The system adds the new loan to the borrowing user's loan collection and the borrowed copy's loan history.
The due date is 30 days for a Student and 60 days for a Faculty user.
The user loan count increases by one
the 3-, 10-, 17- and 31-day overdue flags start as false.
If the copy was ONHOLDSHELF, the system clears its reserved flag and closes the matching reservation.
LibraryManagementSystem_renewBook_renewB: The User, BookCopy and matching Loan must exist
the User must have NORMAL status.
The copy must not be reserved
the due date must be after today
the Loan must have no overdue fee.
A Student must have fewer than 3 renewals and a non-Student user fewer than 6.
From its previous value, the due date is extended by 20 days for a BACHELOR Student, 40 for a MASTER Student, 60 for another Student and 60 for a non-Student user.
